meta.description: Who runs this site, how to send feedback, and where the real help is.

title: Contact Us
subtitle: Who runs this, how to tell us it's wrong, and where the real help lives.
heroImageAlt: A person holding a smartphone with a security app open, next to a laptop.
helplineBody: Call 1930, India's national cybercrime helpline. It is answered in your own language, it works even if you never open a website, and for money that has just left your account it is the fastest thing you can do.
portalBody: cybercrime.gov.in is run by I4C under the Ministry of Home Affairs. It is where an official complaint is registered, and it covers every category this site doesn't.
noDirectoryTitle: Why there's no officer directory here
noDirectoryBody: The real portal lists contact details for state-level grievance and nodal officers. We don't have that data, it changes by jurisdiction and over time, and inventing names, numbers or emails would be exactly the kind of fabricated content this project refuses to ship. That directory lives on the real portal.
aboutThisPrototypeBody: This is an independent hackathon build, not a government service and not affiliated with I4C or the Ministry of Home Affairs. There is no support team behind this page to email or call. See <link>what's real vs mocked</link> for the full, honest breakdown of what this prototype actually does.
feedbackTitle: Tell us what's wrong with this
feedbackBody: Something confusing, a word that made you hesitate, a step you couldn't finish, a screen that didn't work on your phone, that is the most useful thing you can send us. Design feedback from someone who has actually been through this is worth more than any amount of guessing on our side.

feedbackList.one: Copy that was unclear, or asked you something you didn't want to answer
feedbackList.two: Anything that felt like it was blaming you
feedbackList.three: A step where you got stuck, or gave up
feedbackList.four: Anything that didn't work in Hindi, on a small screen, or on a slow connection

whoRunsBody: An independent two-person team, built for the Build What Moves India challenge. No government body, department or agency is involved in it, endorses it, or is responsible for it. There is no organisation behind this beyond the people who wrote it.
